response: {"thought": "語意層沒有「取消」的定義，orders.status 的 0/1/2/3/9 含義未知。改用 shipments 與 payments 的關聯，觀察各狀態是否有出貨、付款紀錄，以推斷哪個代碼代表取消。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"queries": ["SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN s.shipment_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_shipment, SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_payment, SUM(CASE WHEN r.refund_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_refund FROM orders o LEFT JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.status ORDER BY o.status", "SELECT p.payment_status, o.status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id GROUP BY p.payment_status, o.status ORDER BY p.payment_status, o.status"]}}
